name: Trading 212 Sync
description: Automatically sync your Trading 212 investment account (trades, dividends, deposits, withdrawals, fees and interest) into Wealthfolio.
author: dpremoli

permissions.purpose: Create and map a Wealthfolio securities account for Trading 212
Import Trading 212 trades, dividends and cash movements as activities
Match Trading 212 tickers and ISINs to Wealthfolio symbols
Securely store the Trading 212 API key and sync state
Add Trading 212 Sync navigation and configuration pages
